inventory.description: A hearty sandwich that keeps you going in circles. Just like everything else here.
inventory.flavor_text: Tastes like resignation and surprisingly good pulled pork.

inventory.description: Whiskey. Just whiskey. The Irish solution to everything.
inventory.flavor_text: Won't help you find the exit, but you'll care less about finding it.

inventory.description: Spicy enough to wake you from roundabout-induced existential torpor.
inventory.flavor_text: The secret ingredient is the tears of people who almost found the exit.

inventory.description: Named for the longest-serving passenger. Patrick gets misty-eyed when you order it.
inventory.flavor_text: Her favorite. She still orders it every Tuesday. Well, Patrick orders it for her.
inventory.hidden_effect: Unlocks additional Patrick dialogue about Margaret

inventory.description: Everything on the menu, marked up 300% because you're clearly desperate.
inventory.flavor_text: Chef Maeve apologizes in advance. The markup is 'for the irony.'

inventory.description: Black coffee. Nothing else. He's been ordering this for 25 years.
inventory.flavor_text: Bitter. Like accepting that you could leave but choosing not to.

special_items.description: From Patrick and Margaret's 37th. There's always some left.
special_items.flavor_text: Margaret would have wanted you to have some.

barter_options.dialogue: Ah, you've got openers! I'll trade you a roll for the Debaucheryville one.

discoverable_items.description: A worn nub of metal that's been dragging behind the wedding van for 37 years.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: Still attached to a piece of string. Still making noise. Still part of the honeymoon.

discoverable_items.description: A professionally printed guide to living in The Cloverleaf. Has a troublingly thorough waste management section.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: 'Welcome to Your New Home!' it says on the cover. Disturbingly optimistic.

discoverable_items.description: A weathered flyer announcing the 'imminent' opening of the center island gift shop.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: 'Coming This Spring!' ...of 1994. Still spring somewhere, technically.

discoverable_items.description: A detailed map of exactly how to take Exit 6 to the Cliffs of Moher. Seán made it in 1999. He's never used it.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: 'For when you're ready to leave. I never was.' - Seán

discoverable_items.description: A single preserved flower from Margaret's wedding day flower crown. Patrick gave it to you.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: 'She'd want you to have something from her. She always liked visitors.' - Patrick

discoverable_items.description: A learner driver plate. Kevin's been through a few.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: Brenda's handwriting on the back: 'PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD PASS'

discoverable_items.description: From one of Padraig's sheep. Her name is Molly.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: Soft. Calm. Unlike the rest of this place.

discoverable_items.description: After you comforted the GPS, it printed this. It's just 'THANK YOU' repeated 47 times.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: The GPS seems to trust you now. It still doesn't know the way out, but it's trying harder.

quest_items.description: Keys to your questionable rental car. Fergus warned you about The Cloverleaf. You didn't listen.
Awarded to those who escape The Cloverleaf. Only three people have ever earned this. You're one of them.
quest_items.flavor_text: The tour bus community held a ceremony. Patrick cried. Margaret... rested.

quest_items.description: You didn't just survive The Cloverleaf. You LIVED there. For three days. You had a lane.

achievement_items.description: A photo of Bradley and his roundabout girlfriend. She's waving from the tour bus.
